preconditions.description: Attacker must have the MINTER_ROLE or be able to obtain it through role escalation

exploit_hint: Call the mint() function with attacker's address and desired amount. The attacker must have MINTER_ROLE, which can be obtained if they have DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE or if the current admin grants it. After minting, the attacker can sell tokens on Uniswap for profit.
